title: Proof-of-Human Dating Booth
oneLiner: A playful profile lab that helps singles prove their photos are real enough without looking staged, fake, or desperate.
signalRefs: Reddit r/digitalminimalism: fatigue with AI generated content and bot comments
Dating Industry Insights: singles see AI photos as a dating red flag
Reddit r/DatingOverSixty: suspicion of AI generated dating profiles
stitchPrompt: Create a playful responsive web app called "Proof-of-Human Dating Booth" for dating-app users who want attractive photos without triggering AI-photo or catfish suspicion. The app displays a photo lineup, authenticity tags, over-edit suspicion meter, proof mix score, casual proof-shot prompt generator, caption tone check, and a shareable "verified human vibe" card. Required screens/sections: bold booth-style header, photo strip, scoring panel, prompt wheel, before/after profile mix, and share card. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with expressive color accents, tactile booth controls, witty microcopy, and polished portfolio energy while keeping text legible and the core scoring UI usable.
